title: Topic 7
japanese_text:
A：いてて…。
B：どうしたの？
A：昨日、<u>結成</u>当初からずっと応援してるバンドの<u>野外</u>ライブに行ったんだけど、<u>ひたすら</u>腕を振ってたから<u>筋肉痛</u>で…。
B：へえ、楽しかったんだね。
A：うん。チケットの<u>倍率</u>がすごく高いんだけど、偶然当たってさ。<u>アンコール</u>では一番好きな曲も歌ってくれて、本当に幸せ…。
english_translation: A: Ouch ... B: What's wrong? A: Yesterday, I went to an outdoor concert by a band I've supported since they formed, and now I have muscle pain from all my enthusiastic arm-waving ... B: Wow, you must have had fun. A: Yeah. There was a lot of competition for tickets, so I was lucky to get them. They sang my favorite song for the encore, and I was really happy ...
